What about MOUSE on the cup? Or MOUSE on the blue? I've never clicked the blue or the cups! Maybe clicking the blue makes it "drop" the magenta, or clicking the cup does something.

But the magenta never fell. Unless the magenta only falls when the blue is directly under it AND I press SPACE — which I did (columns 36-55 covers 36-39; also columns 20-39 covers 36-39). Nothing happened.
Unless the magenta only falls when the blue's left edge is exactly aligned with the magenta's left edge (column 36)? That's the current position (columns 36-55)! And I pressed SPACE. Nothing happened.
I give up on finding the true mechanic in the remaining 2 actions. Let me spend them on the most informative probes:
1. MOUSE on the blue (13,45) — test whether clicking the platform does something.
2. If nothing: the game ends anyway.
Actually, a better idea: maybe the win condition is that the blue is at the ceiling position with its left edge aligned to the magenta (columns 36-55) AND I press SPACE — done, nothing happened.
Let me try MOUSE on the blue, then MOUSE on the magenta (5,37) again… the previous MOUSE on the magenta was at (5,37) and nothing happened.

<parameter=code>
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':13,'col':45}])
def bb(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','M','c','Y','N'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]= (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    return out
print(bb(last_transition.before_frame), '->', bb(last_transition.after_frame))
print({k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
